task: Allow trusted successor reevaluation to proceed across only revalidatable main-overlap classes—read-only dependency changes and explicit modify operations—while preserving fail-closed behavior for unsafe intended-operation overlap and all non-fast-forward main drift.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The bounded rehearsal now has U01 and U02 merged. U03 is STALE with RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT because main advanced from 1bf9ced0... to bc6c11e0... while touching two files in U03 scope: scripts/lib/shoperation-release-unit-runtime.mjs as a required dependency and tests/control-plane-release-unit-production-surface.test.ts as an explicit modify operation. The newly merged modify-patch materializer can safely reconcile the intended modify via exact three-way patch or fail closed on conflict, and fresh successor reevaluation is designed to re-prove changed dependencies. However proveTrustedMainAdvance blocks any scope overlap before either mechanism can run. The guard therefore needs operation-aware overlap classification rather than unconditional file-level overlap rejection.
observableOutcomes: Fast-forward main advance with no scope overlap remains PASS.
Overlap only on requiredDependencyFiles that are not intended writes may proceed as revalidation-required dependency overlap.
Overlap on intended files proceeds only when the manifest declares that exact file as operation=modify.
Create/delete/rename/regenerate or otherwise unclassified intended overlap remains RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT.
The trusted main-advance proof records exact overlap categories and the runtime validator recomputes and verifies them from the manifest; the proof cannot self-assert a safe category.
Modify overlap is not auto-accepted as merged content: successor reevaluation must still materialize the source delta onto current main, and RELEASE_UNIT_MODIFY_PATCH_CONFLICT remains blocking.
Dependency overlap is not treated as unchanged: fresh semantic projection/Plan Gate continues to run against current main before authorization.
Replaying the immutable rehearsal source allows U03 to reach three-way materialization instead of being blocked by coarse scope-overlap detection.
unresolvedRisks: Allowing all dependency overlap could hide a dependency change if fresh reevaluation were accidentally skipped.
A file that is both dependency and intended write must be classified by its write operation, not receive a dependency-only bypass.
A malicious or stale proof could claim safe overlap categories unless the runtime validator recomputes them independently.
A modify overlap could still conflict semantically and must remain blocked by the patch materializer.
Rename source/target overlap must not be misclassified as modify.
The existing zero-overlap proof contract and tests must be upgraded without weakening ancestry or exact-SHA checks.

in: Refine proveTrustedMainAdvance in scripts/release-unit-github-runtime.mjs to classify overlap as dependency-only, modify-intended, or unsafe.
Refine validateReleaseUnitMainAdvanceProof in scripts/lib/shoperation-release-unit-runtime.mjs to independently recompute and validate the exact overlap categories.
Keep fast-forward ancestry and exact fromSha/toSha requirements unchanged.
Permit proof PASS only when unsafeOverlapFiles is empty.
Add regressions proving dependency-only and modify overlap PASS, and create/delete/rename/non-fast-forward overlap BLOCK.
Add proof-tamper regressions showing the runtime validator rejects fabricated overlap categories.
out: No bypass of three-way modify patch conflict handling.
No change to immutable source SHA or release-state branch by hand.
No acceptance of create/delete/rename/regenerate intended overlap.
No relaxation of exact predecessor merge receipt, main ancestry, child CI, Truth or Lifecycle requirements.
No storefront, template, Supabase or deployment changes.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This proof controls whether a successor may reconcile onto a main that changed within its declared scope. Over-permission could hide real write conflicts; under-permission deadlocks the already-safe reevaluation and patch materialization paths. The proof producer and consumer must therefore derive the same categories independently.

acceptanceCriteria: proveTrustedMainAdvance still requires fromSha to be an ancestor of toSha.
No-overlap fast-forward behavior and proof contract remain valid.
A changed file that exists only in requiredDependencyFiles may be categorized as dependencyOverlapFiles.
A changed intended file may be categorized as modifyOverlapFiles only when its declared operation is exactly modify.
A file that is both intended and dependency follows intended-operation classification and cannot use the dependency-only allowance.
Any overlap for create/delete/rename/regenerate or for an intended file without exactly one modify operation is unsafe and blocks with RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_ADVANCE_SCOPE_OVERLAP.
Proof contains changedFiles, scopeFiles, overlapFiles, dependencyOverlapFiles, modifyOverlapFiles and unsafeOverlapFiles.
validateReleaseUnitMainAdvanceProof independently recomputes expected categories from changedFiles and manifest and rejects any mismatch or non-empty unsafe overlap.
Fresh successor reevaluation and modify materialization remain mandatory after trusted main-advance PASS.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
After merge, immutable rehearsal replay advances U03 beyond current RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT without editing persisted U03 state manually.
invariants: The proof issuer cannot choose its own safe overlap classification without runtime recomputation.
Dependency-only overlap never grants write authority to that dependency file.
Modify overlap never bypasses three-way conflict detection.
Unsafe intended operation overlap remains fail-closed.
Exact predecessor/current main SHAs remain bound into the proof.
The fresh projection remains the authority for successor plan/dependency semantics.

failureModes: Dependency-only overlap remains blocked before fresh reevaluation.
Modify overlap remains blocked before three-way materialization.
Unsafe create/delete/rename overlap is accidentally accepted.
Runtime validator accepts a proof whose categorized overlap arrays do not match the manifest.
File listed as both dependency and intended write is incorrectly treated as dependency-only.
Proof producer and proof validator normalize paths differently and disagree nondeterministically.
edgeCases: changed files outside all successor scope
both dependency and intended modify same file
fabricated proof omits one overlap file
same overlap arrays in different ordering
non-fast-forward history with otherwise safe modify overlap

alternatives.summary: Permit only dependency-read and explicit modify overlap in the trusted main-advance proof, then rely on mandatory fresh reevaluation and patch conflict checks.
alternatives.reason: Reuses existing stronger downstream proofs instead of blocking before they can run, without granting general overlap authority.

alternatives.summary: Remove the overlap prohibition and trust fresh reevaluation for every operation type.
alternatives.reason: Would unnecessarily expose create/delete/rename/regenerate write conflicts to later stages and weaken the current fail-closed boundary.

alternatives.summary: Keep current rule and manually avoid main changes to U03 scope.
alternatives.reason: The rehearsal itself requires Control Plane repairs that legitimately evolve dependencies and modify targets; this would make resumability self-defeating.

alternatives.summary: Manually rebuild or rebase PR #1074 onto current main.
alternatives.reason: Would bypass the generic orchestration defect and invalidate the rehearsal proof.

specialistReviews.finding: Allowing overlap can blur the boundary between proof of main ancestry and proof of merge safety.
specialistReviews.resolution: Main-advance proof only categorizes which overlap classes are eligible for downstream proof; modify merge safety is still decided by materializeReleaseUnit, and dependency semantics by fresh Plan reevaluation.

specialistReviews.finding: A self-declared safe overlap list would be forgeable.
specialistReviews.resolution: validateReleaseUnitMainAdvanceProof must independently recompute overlap categories from manifest and changedFiles.

specialistReviews.finding: The U03 dependency file changed only because trusted materialization infrastructure was repaired, while the intended test file changed in both main and source intent.
specialistReviews.resolution: Dependency-only overlap proceeds to fresh semantic proof; intended modify overlap proceeds to exact three-way patch or conflict.

specialistReviews.finding: U01 and U02 are closed and U03 is the only remaining child. Current blocker is pre-materialization RELEASE_UNIT_MAIN_DRIFT.
specialistReviews.resolution: Repair trusted-main overlap classification, then replay unchanged immutable source and require U03 child proof.

specialistReviews.finding: The live rehearsal exposed an interaction between trusted main advance and the later-added patch-aware materializer.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add explicit regression matrix covering both producer and validator so the overlap boundary remains durable.

challenge.scenario: Main changes only a required dependency.
challenge.finding: Zero-overlap rule blocks before fresh semantic reevaluation.
challenge.resolution: Classify as dependencyOverlapFiles and require downstream fresh projection.

challenge.scenario: Main changes an intended modify file.
challenge.finding: Patch materializer cannot run because main-advance guard blocks first.
challenge.resolution: Classify as modifyOverlapFiles and defer actual merge safety to three-way materialization.

challenge.scenario: Main changes an intended create file.
challenge.finding: Target existence/content may conflict with source create.

challenge.scenario: Main changes an intended delete or rename path.
challenge.finding: Deletion/rename semantics can invalidate target identity.

challenge.scenario: File is both dependency and intended modify.
challenge.finding: Dependency allowance must not override write semantics.
challenge.resolution: Classify intended writes first; only explicit modify may pass.

challenge.scenario: Proof claims safe categories that do not match changedFiles/manifest.
challenge.finding: Could forge authority if consumer trusts producer arrays.
challenge.resolution: Runtime validator recomputes all categories and compares exact normalized arrays.

challenge.scenario: Modify overlap later conflicts at patch application.
challenge.finding: Main-advance PASS must not imply merge PASS.
Read-only dependency cannot be assumed harmless.
challenge.resolution: Fresh successor projection/Plan Gate remains mandatory before authorization.

challenge.scenario: Mixed dependency, modify and create overlap.
challenge.finding: One safe category must not mask one unsafe file.
challenge.resolution: Any unsafeOverlapFiles entry makes proveTrustedMainAdvance BLOCK.

Merge only after exact PR-head SUCCESS and green main CI.
Replay immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and require U03 to reach patch materialization/child proof without manual PR or release-state edits.

requirements.requirement: Trusted successor main-advance proof must permit only overlap classes that are re-proven downstream—read-only dependencies and explicit modify operations—while unsafe write overlap and non-fast-forward history remain fail closed.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Create/delete/rename/regenerate or otherwise unsafe intended overlap may not pass trusted main advance.
A fabricated overlap category in the proof may not be accepted by the runtime validator.
Modify overlap permission may not bypass downstream three-way conflict detection.
Dependency overlap permission may not bypass fresh successor semantic reevaluation.
